description: devflow guard (refuses writes to real data, touching or reading secrets and reverting secretary edits; asks before release and forced-push commands) and the session-start summary (branch, uncommitted files, CI on HEAD, the plan's next open step). Both do nothing in a project without .claude/devflow.json.

hooks.command: if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/devflow.json" ]; then if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv run --no-project --quiet python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py"; rc=$?; else rc=127; fi; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && [ "$rc" -ne 2 ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"devflow guard did not run (exit %s) -- not checked"}}' "$rc"; exit 0; fi; exit "$rc"; fi
if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/devflow.json" ]; then uv run --no-project --quiet python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session_start.py"; fi
